<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Docking Bay 94''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ドッキング・ベイ９４</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトサイド：ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、２フォース必要。ダークサイド：ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、１フォース必要。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-291o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94.

'''Card text:''' Light Side: Moving from here to another docking bay costs 2 Force. Dark Side: Moving from here to another docking bay costs 1 Force.

'''Lore:'''

Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark)|Tatooine: Docking Bay 94]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100.
